fusions.name: Held at Full Draw
fusions.desc: After a 1.2 second draw, looses the tip at the first enemy it meets, which deals 32 damage and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Quiver of Thongs
fusions.desc: Looses 3 lash-tips in a fan out to 8 tiles; each deals 6 damage. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Slack Line
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Tension Kept
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
